title: PDF Merger
description: Merge multiple PDF files into one document securely in your browser.

seo.title: Merge PDF Files Online for Free | NikTool
seo.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one document online for free. Reorder your files and merge them privately without uploading them to a server.

openGraph.title: Free PDF Merger Online | NikTool
openGraph.description: Reorder and combine PDF files privately in your browser.

faqs.question: How do I merge PDF files?
faqs.answer: Choose two or more PDF files, arrange them in the order you want, and select Merge PDFs. The combined document will download when it is ready.

faqs.question: Are my PDF files uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Your files are processed locally in your browser and are not uploaded to NikTool.

faqs.question: Can I change the order of the PDFs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the Move up and Move down buttons beside each file before merging.

faqs.question: Can I merge password-protected PDFs?
faqs.answer: Password-protected or encrypted PDFs must be unlocked before they can be merged with this tool.
